scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:dashboard" "npm run start:inprogress" "npm run start:history" "npm run start:stocks" "npm run start:search"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:inprogress && npm run build:stocks && npm run build:history && npm run build:search && npm run postbuild:all
scripts.postbuild:all: mkdir -p dist/dashboard/browser/inprogress && cp -r dist/dashboard/inprogress/browser/* dist/dashboard/browser/inprogress/ && mkdir -p dist/dashboard/browser/stocks && cp -r dist/dashboard/stocks/browser/* dist/dashboard/browser/stocks/ && mkdir -p dist/dashboard/browser/history && cp -r dist/dashboard/history/browser/* dist/dashboard/browser/history/ && mkdir -p dist/dashboard/browser/search && cp -r dist/dashboard/search/browser/* dist/dashboard/browser/search/
